shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH + VEF PipeSystem soft compat; Reverse Commands soft compat (reflection-only).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid mineable rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- Animal policy (conservative): pets follow master, obedient pets get send gizmos, non-pen unrestricted pets cross for food; pen animals never.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase 2x2 (0.6x, quality scales climb), elevator (0.35x, power bridge, Extend gizmos, two-hop rides).
- Climb = 90t x type x quality x slider. All minifiable (uninstall collapses far side). Bomb >= 40 punches constructed rooftops. Giddy-Up mounted riders blocked.
- Stairs do NOT unroof anything below. Sky-side landing platforms (footprint+1) are RoofSurface, exempt from air-reversion while stairs stand.
- Migration diagnostics: verbose-log lines at each TryTowards decision.

## Sky surface model (round-10 final 2026-07-19)
- Owned terrains: AB_OpenAir (see-through, impassable), AB_RoofSurface (corrugated steel, muted vanilla-toned), AB_MountainTop (walkable cap; visual comes from the overlay, texture is a fail-open fallback).
- COVERED-BELOW rule (LevelSync.CoveredBelow): constructed roof below, OR artificial impassable edifice supporting an adjacent constructed roof - steel to the OUTER wall edge. Roof events re-sync 8 neighbors; wall-only changes converge on the sweep.
- MOUNTAIN CAP RENDERING (SectionLayer_ABMountainCap): quads drawn with THE VANILLA FOG MATERIAL (MatBases.FogOfWar clones, fully-fogged vertex colors) so cap and real fog are pixel-identical and their boundary dissolves (hand-picked hexes could never match - playtest rounds 6-9). Two queues derived at runtime: low (above terrain/edge shadows) for the body, high (cutout+1) for wall-facing rim tiles that swallow the rock overhang decals. Cells emit an OVERLAP-FREE 3x3 tiling (stacking two translucent fog quads darkened rims into faint 1x1 edges - round 10); edifice-holding cells get a plain base quad so sprites are never clipped. Regenerates on Terrain|Buildings flags; quads under unmined rock make mining reveal with no regen.
- MINED FLOORS: vanilla's leave-terrain (rough-hewn) is KEPT as the mined marker (no restoration); the overlay fills those cells flat in the source rock's own wall/edge color (graphicData tint, stuff color fallback, modded rocks automatic) - tunnels read in the nearest edge color against the fog mass (round 10, user-specified). LevelSync.TryGetMinedRockColor maps leave-terrain to rock tint.
- Mountains: mass erodes one step to the walkable unfogged ledge; wall core solid rock + thick roof; fog deep interior only (radius-2 rule; fogging faces swallowed the ledge - round-4 regression, reverted). Ore lumps in the mass (ABOreGen 6/10k, commonality-weighted).
- Sync self-heal: subscription retry (250t) + ReconcileRooftops (FinalizeInit + 2000t), platform-exempt, CoveredBelow-driven; natural roofs generation-time only.

## See-below renderer
- Static pass: lower map's section meshes via cloned materials in a queue band derived at RUNTIME from a real terrain material (map shaders do not depth-write).
- Dynamic pass: ONE-WAY MIRROR - below things draw only if unroofed (any roof), unfogged, in view, under open air. Filtered per-thing loop, reflection fallback.
- Air-cells light mask (night cap 0.45); silhouettes suppressed; ceiling hints; far clip 70. Weather decider suppressed on pocket levels.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified in-game 2026-07-19)
- Logistics: outbound haul + inbound fetch + demand pull + export pinning + carried-cargo delivery. Column-aware stuff picker (transpiler + ResourceCounter augmentation).
- Needs: rest to owned bed anywhere in column or free bed on linked level; food redirect incl. eligible pets. Medical rescue three ways: (1) auto work-giver on the victim's level (Doctor work, same-faction, vanilla parity); (2) EMERGENCY WORK MIGRATION - the emergency JobGiver_Work instance migrates via TryMigrateForEmergencyWork with a plausibility pre-check (fire / downed-out-of-bed / tend-needing faction pawn or prisoner on the linked map) BEFORE any cooldown is charged, own 600t cooldown so failed scans never starve the normal scanner (vanilla caches emergency givers - rescue/tend/firefight - into a separate list the normal pass never scans, so doctors on other levels were blind); (3) assignment-free forced float-menu rescue (FloatMenuOptionProvider_RescueAcrossLevels, appears when right-click rescue finds no local bed, mirrors vanilla RescuePawn gating, covers friendly guests). Capture via float menu. All ride CarriedIntent through StairTransfer.
- One-colony UI: tables append other levels (Fluffy Animal Tab via RecachePawns); colonist bar ordered per column; level buttons in global controls (Declutter bypass); camera preserved; beds alert aggregated.
- Power/pipes/climate bridges per link; ABPendingOrders replay.

## Performance architecture
- ABGuard plain-bool switches; AnySkyLevels static gate; NearestUsableStairsCached per-tick memo; shared stairs helpers; small caches. Recurring: weather 150t, pipes/climate 250t, power 10t hash, rooftop sweep 2000t. Zero recurring cost with no levels. Emergency migration pre-check is allocation-free (fire lister count + faction/prisoner list walk) and only charges its cooldown when an emergency is actually plausible.

## Compat
- DBH + VEF bridges; Reverse Commands; Fluffy Animal Tab; Declutter UI; Giddy-Up; incompatibleWith MultiFloors + ZLevels1.1; RimThreaded unsupported; foreign pocket maps read as level-0.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Floating rim/cap cells on natural roof loss (rare); sky projectile dim over air; tall below-sprites clip at rooftop edges; wall-only edits converge on sweep cadence (<=33s); mined-floor rim tint boundaries are hard edges by design; bill radius vs stairs delivery; couples as singles in beds alert; RC direct links only; restaurants per-level; stuff picker direct links only.
- Multiple doctors can pile onto one cross-level emergency within the same pre-check window (reservations dedupe once the first real job starts).
- Threat policy: pocket levels raid-free; opt-ins slated for T8.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 DONE. Optimization + compat pass DONE. Playtest rounds 2-10 DONE (2026-07-19). Round-11: forced cross-level rescue float-menu option VERIFIED in-game; emergency work migration (auto cross-level rescue/tend/firefight response) implemented, pending verification alongside round-10 visuals.
- Next: T5 publishing prep. Backlog: T8 threat opt-ins, T9 pipe depth, T11 world integration.

## Status
Round-11: float-menu rescue verified; emergency migration compiling, awaiting relaunch verification. Then T5 publishing prep.
